import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import pbs_black_retry as b

r = Path.cwd().resolve()
name = 'diag_train_look_first_unit_host_preflight_01'
guard_file = 'results/diag_train_look_first_unit_black_guard_plan_01.json'
reference = {'file': guard_file, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256((r / guard_file).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
guard, _ = b.logged(r, reference)
proof = guard['metrics']['strict_black_gate_proof']
b.require(guard['_meta']['exit_code'] == 0 and guard['metrics']['technical_retry_plan_ready'] is True
          and guard['metrics']['all_other_plan_values_equal'] is True, 'Exact identity-only plan not authenticated')
new_name = 'gen_train_look_first_unit_01_retry1'
command = guard['metrics']['producer_command']
index, previous = b.rotation(r)
previous_host = None
if previous:
    _, body = b.file_ref(r, previous['payload'], 'logs/pbs')
    previous_host = json.loads(body)['requested_host']
host = b.next_host(b.VERSION, index, previous_host)
binding = b.validate_request_host(r, host=host, retry_of=proof['job_id'], evidence_path=guard_file,
    evidence_sha256=reference['sha256'], name=new_name, command=command,
    task='T01', group='G01', gpus=1, wall_seconds=1630)
submit = ['python3', 'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py', '--name', new_name, '--task', 'T01',
    '--budget-group', 'G01', '--gpus', '1', '--walltime', '00:27:10', '--host', host,
    '--retry-of', proof['job_id'], '--black-retry-evidence', guard_file,
    '--black-retry-evidence-sha256', reference['sha256'], '--', *command]
metrics = {'validated': True, 'host_authorization': binding, 'submit_command': submit,
           'scope': 'Preflight only; original submitter repeats under reservation lock;20min Q fallback unchanged'}
with (r / 'results' / (name + '.json')).open('x') as handle:
    json.dump({'metrics': metrics, 'config': {'name': name},
               'sources': [dict(reference, metrics_sha256=guard['_meta']['metrics_sha256'])]},
              handle, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    handle.write('\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: ' + json.dumps(metrics, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
